description: This file defines the OrderProductEntity class, which extends OrderProduct and implements Serializable. It adds properties for ordered quantity and associated ReadableProduct, along with their getters and setters.

classes.name: OrderProductEntity
classes.description: A Serializable Java class extending OrderProduct, representing an order item with quantity and product details.

methods.name: setOrderedQuantity
methods.description: Sets the quantity of the product ordered.

methods.name: getOrderedQuantity
methods.description: Returns the quantity of the product ordered.

methods.name: getProduct
methods.description: Returns the ReadableProduct associated with the order.

methods.name: setProduct
methods.description: Sets the ReadableProduct for the order item.
